newsitem.title: USA: RTRS - Australian investor takes control of Mason Oil.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Australian investor takes control of Mason Oil.

text.p: Mason Oil Co said Monday that Craig Carpenter of Salt Lake City sold a controlling interest in the company to Paul Ingram and John Naylor.

Ingram, of Sarasota, Fla., and Naylor, an Australian citizen living in the Philippines, own Hemley Exploration Pty Ltd. The Australian company holds the entire working interest, subject to royalty agreements, in two petroleum exploration licenses in the state of South Australia.
The agreement transferring control says that Ingram and Naylor intend to have Mason Oil acquire the rights of Hemley Exploration, directly or indirectly.
Their exploration licenses cover 17,188 square kilometers, or 4.2 million acres.
